{{Quote|Landing guidance droid LG3-18 to incoming vessel: I am programmed to guide inbound ships to public landing platforms. Please follow my vector.|LG3-18|<ref name="RA" />}}
'''LG3-18''' was a [[Signal droid|landing guidance droid]] with [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] that was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="RA" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]] to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> LG3-18 was programmed to lead incoming [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to public landing platforms. When the droid's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] picked up the [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]''<ref name="RA" /> in 5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the droid contacted the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jan Ors]] and, after introducing itself, provided Ors a landing vector for a public landıng platform at [[Launch Deck Three]], which Ors agreed to follow.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
LG3-18 was introduced in the [[1998]] [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]], which was based on the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent|novella of the same name]]<ref name="RA" /> written by [[William C. Dietz]]; in that story, an unnamed remote-controlled landing drone with strobing lights led the ''Crow'' toward the public landing platforms.<ref name="RA2">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

The droid's voice actor was uncredited.

As LG3-18's name was only spoken in the audio drama, the spelling of the droid's name in this article is conjectural.
